_readme: Contract deployments that passed an independent audit. The API refuses STELLAR_NETWORK=mainnet unless every contract id it is configured with (SOROBAN_CONTRACT_ID, and WEB_AUTH_CONTRACT_ID / ATTESTATION_CONTRACT_ID when those features are on) is listed under 'mainnet' with its audit. An entry counts only when it carries an audit with a report_url, so an id alone is never evidence of a review. Add an entry after the report is final and the deployed wasm hash matches the audited build. Entry shape: {contract, contract_id, wasm_hash, deployed_at, deploy_tx, audit: {firm, report_url, report_sha256, completed_at, commit}}. The 'testnet' list is a record only; it is never consulted by the guard and its entries are not audited. See docs/runbooks/mainnet-launch-checklist.md and docs/compliance.md.
